title: Blasphemous Blazery 3
description: A mod that makes Blaze Rods fully accessible in peaceful mode. With the catch that it takes a LARGE amount of time to get them.
body:
**Blasphemous Blazery 3** is a mod that makes _Blaze Rods_ entirely accessible within _peaceful mode_. With the catch that it takes a **Ludicrous amount of time** to get them. The mod itself adds **numerous items** whose **sole purpose** is to **pad out time for no rhyme or reason** in order to make the process of attaining _Blaze Rods_ in _peaceful mode_ as **time consuming as possible**.

**Roughly Enough Items** is **HIGHLY** Recommended as to make recipe traversal simpler.

TL;DR: Borderline joke/troll mod created with the primary purpose of extending gameplay as much as possible and just so happens to have a niche yet beneficial secondary purpose.
